headline: Nutrien Signs Lease for Up to $1 Billion Potash Export Terminal in Washington
summary: Saskatchewan potash producer Nutrien has signed a lease to invest up to $1 billion in developing a new export terminal facility in Washington State.
why: Nutrien is the world's largest producer of potash fertilizer; expanding Pacific export infrastructure enhances its logistics capabilities for shipments to Asian agricultural markets.

impacts.name: Nutrien
impacts.why: Nutrien committed up to $1 billion to construct a new port export terminal in Washington State.
